schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Mammoth Pool Lake (Region 4, Fresno Co.) for sub-catchable-size Brown Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of October-December. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
